# All tools

Each tool is `POST /v1/tools/<name>` with its arguments as a JSON object, and returns `{"result": "..."}`. A key needs the capability listed to call it; see [Authentication](../README.md#authentication).

| Tool | What it does | Capability | Group |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`remember`](memory.md) | Remember (extract & reconcile facts) | `write` | Memory |
| [`recall`](memory.md) | Recall from current memory | `read` | Memory |
| [`recall_related`](memory.md) | Recall (relational / graph) | `read` | Memory |
| [`forget`](memory.md) | Forget / retract (kept in history for audit) | `write` | Memory |
| [`history`](memory.md) | Change history for a subject | `read` | Memory |
| [`list_memories`](memory.md) | List current memories | `read` | Memory |
| [`get_memory`](memory.md) | Get one memory by id | `read` | Memory |
| [`update_memory`](memory.md) | Update a memory (audit-preserving) | `write` | Memory |
| [`check_before_act`](safety-and-approval.md) | Safety check before acting on a fact | `read` | Safety and approval |
| [`safe_recall`](safety-and-approval.md) | Gated recall — answers only if safe to act on | `read` | Safety and approval |
| [`pending_changes`](safety-and-approval.md) | List changes awaiting human approval | `read` | Safety and approval |
| [`confirm_change`](safety-and-approval.md) | Approve a pending change | `approve` | Safety and approval |
| [`reject_change`](safety-and-approval.md) | Discard a pending change | `approve` | Safety and approval |
| [`set_reconcile_policy`](safety-and-approval.md) | Configure how a shared space reconciles conflicting sources | `admin` | Safety and approval |
| [`get_reconcile_policy`](safety-and-approval.md) | Show a shared space's reconciliation policy | `read` | Safety and approval |
| [`record_decision`](accountability.md) | Record a decision + the beliefs behind it | `write` | Accountability |
| [`explain_decision`](accountability.md) | Explain a past decision (why the agent acted) | `verify` | Accountability |
| [`attest`](accountability.md) | Attest the current value of a subject (signed proof) | `write` | Accountability |
| [`verify_receipt`](accountability.md) | Verify a signed receipt / attestation | `verify` | Accountability |
| [`audit_log`](accountability.md) | Audit log (accountability trail) | `verify` | Accountability |
| [`verify_audit`](accountability.md) | Verify the audit log is untampered | `verify` | Accountability |
| [`export_public_key`](accountability.md) | Export the public key for third-party verification | `verify` | Accountability |
| [`delete`](compliance.md) | Erase a subject permanently (GDPR erasure) | `delete` | Compliance |
| [`delete_all`](compliance.md) | Erase ALL memory for a user permanently (GDPR erasure) | `admin` | Compliance |
| [`export_memory`](compliance.md) | Export all memory as JSON (GDPR access/portability) | `read` | Compliance |
| [`purge_expired`](compliance.md) | Purge records older than N days (retention) | `admin` | Compliance |
| [`create_principal`](administration.md) | Create a principal (user/agent) + API key | `admin` | Administration |
| [`list_principals`](administration.md) | List principals of this deployment | `admin` | Administration |
| [`revoke_principal`](administration.md) | Revoke a principal's access | `admin` | Administration |
| [`license_status`](administration.md) | Show the license / edition status | `verify` | Administration |
| [`stats`](administration.md) | Usage stats & KPIs | `verify` | Administration |
| [`health`](administration.md) | Health check | `verify` | Administration |
